Hi Emily — great catch and thanks for flagging this. Apologies for any confusion. To be explicit: the US moved clocks forward on Mar 8 (spring forward), so Eastern Time is now EDT (UTC-4). The UK (and most of EU) does not move until Mar 29 this year, so there is a 1-hour displacement during the intervening weeks. That means an invite originally intended as 11:00 AM ET = 16:00 London (when the US was on EST) will now appear as 11:00 AM EDT = 15:00 London.

To keep your UK team at the 16:00 local time they expect, I propose we shift the session to 12:00 PM ET / 17:00 GMT on Mar 20. Two clear options: 

Option A (recommended): Move to 12:00 PM ET / 17:00 GMT — preserves the 4pm London local time for your team and keeps APAC attendees in an acceptable evening window.
Option B: Keep 11:00 AM ET / 15:00 GMT — Redwood team stays at the earlier time, UK joins one hour earlier than originally discussed.

If you confirm Option A I will update the calendar invite and push an updated .ics. I attached a short demo agenda and the draft .ics to this message for your review.

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (132 KB), mar20-demo.ics (calendar stub)

Thanks,
